vectors.description: a bundle of a rule set reads, and is written back as it was
a bundle of a decision table states the digest of the rule set the table compiles to
without cases, a bundle is written without the key
an empty list of cases is written without the key
output keys are written sorted by code point
a bundle of another engine keeps its contract as recorded, though this engine would derive another one
a bundle made by an engine of another name is read
case files keep their order
integers in a contract are kept, up to 2^53 - 1
a bundle reads from YAML, settings of its rule set at their defaults

given.yaml:
version: 1
bundle:
  id: acme/discounts
  revision: '1'
  ruleset:
    rules:
    - name: vip
      when: {op: gt, left: {op: field, path: [years]}, right: {op: const, value: 5}}
      then:
        discount: {op: const, value: {$decimal: '0.15'}}
  ruleset_digest: sha256:5a0e590cb8f3bd57392ede84c0d0c4596cf9374fefcbcc6b28ed61421878f312
  engine:
    name: cleanrules
    version: 1.0.0-conformance.1
    limits:
      max_size: 16777216
      max_nesting: 1024
      max_depth: 256
      max_path_segments: 256
      max_table_size: 2097152
      max_values: 1000000
  contract:
    input: {type: object}
    output: {keys: [discount]}
